headline: H.Res. 856 would have created a House select committee to investigate the resignation of House Chaplain Father Patrick Conroy, but the House voted to table it or send it back to committee in April 2018.
what_it_does: The resolution would have set up a select committee to look into the actions and motivations behind the resignation of Father Patrick Conroy, the House Chaplain. Because the House voted to table it or send it back to committee, the measure was not adopted and no committee was created. The summary provided does not describe the committee's powers, budget, or deadlines.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: Members would have been asked to create and staff a select committee to examine the chaplain's resignation.

who_it_affects.group: Father Patrick Conroy and the House Chaplain's office
who_it_affects.how: The former chaplain's resignation would have been the subject of a formal House investigation.
